question: Does the repaired prediction-to-measurement link choose measurements that lead to better mechanism decisions than the magnitude tie-break, under the same validator, budget and costs?
held_out: compounds by the frozen five-fold skeleton split, in cell lines seen in training; not unseen cell contexts

labels.eliminate_b: profile_matches_h1 if the reference's own class is h1, else profile_matches_h2

forecasts.consequences: from the registered OutcomeRule objects of the episode evidence path
forecasts.dynamic: step-2 references restricted to those whose own leave-one-out reading category at the step-1 condition equals the held-out compound's step-1 category; fewer than the minimum falls back to unconditioned references

selector.gate: pooled shrunk P(correct) > 2 x pooled shrunk P(wrong)
selector.rank: one-sided 95% lower bound of P(correct) - P(wrong), then support, cost, exposure time, magnitude priority, identifier

primary.P-A: correct-decision rate at budget 2, da minus magnitude, tier B and tier A separately

secondary.S1: production_after minus production_before: correct-decision rate and utility, per tier
secondary.S2: da minus ec_cards_1ref (selector effect); da minus da_2ref (support effect)
secondary.S5: da_permuted minus magnitude; da minus da_permuted
all_arms: action distribution by time, dose and line at steps 1 and 2
per-class correct-rate differences of da against magnitude
secondary.calibration: served v2 step-1 menu forecasts: pooled shrunk P(correct) against the realised correct elimination; ECE with 10 bins and Brier, pooled and on the true hypothesis's branch; by support stratum (1, 2-3, 4-8, >8) with the realised mean discrimination against the mean one-sided lower bound

classification.PROMOTE: unavailable: the episodes were analysed in block 2 and informed the design
classification.SHADOW: P-A positive with the interval excluding zero in at least one tier and the other tier's lower bound above -0.02; da wrong-elimination rate no more than 0.02 above magnitude in each tier; no tier with the utility difference's interval entirely below zero; da_permuted short of da's gain over magnitude in each tier where da gains; served-forecast ECE at most 0.10 in each tier
classification.REJECT: P-A negative with the interval excluding zero in either tier, or da wrong-elimination rate more than 0.02 above magnitude in either tier

wiring_repair_rule: keep the power-aware tie-break if production_after utility exceeds production_before with the interval excluding zero in both tiers; report the wrong-elimination change
seen_before_freeze: all block-2 outputs and the block-2 card audit; Phase-B counts from block-2 records; no episode with the new selector or v2 forecasts
